newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Fujitsu, Tomen win phone contract.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu, Tomen win phone contract.

text.p: Globe Telecom said on Tuesday it had awarded a $32.3-million phone supply contract to Fujitsu Ltd and Tomen Corp.
"The Globe Telecom board approved the winning tender submitted by Fujitsu-Tomen," it said in a statement.
Globe said the contract involves the supply of fibre optic cables to connect 150,000 telephone lines in the main islands of Luzon, including Metro Manila, and Mindanao.
It said the project is part of Globe's plan to install 700,000 lines all over the country between 1996 and 1998.
Globe said it has so far installed 254,290 phone lines nationwide.
